title: India's tigers, census by census
caption:
Five counts, one direction.

The survey runs every four years, and the 2022 estimate of 3,682 comes with a range of 3,167 to 3,925. A sixth national count began in 2026.

Source: NTCA / Wildlife Institute of India, Status of Tigers 2022; PIB.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
